SpartaDex on Arbitrum is a Uniswap-V2 fork (factory 0xFe8EC10Fe07A6a6f4A2584f8cD9FE232930eAF55 + 8 standard Uni V2 pairs) plus a plain ERC20 SPARTA token (0x11f98c7e42a367dab4f200d2fdc460fb445ce9a8). No public function pays a caller: factory setters are owner/feeToSetter-gated and createPair is ACL-gated; pairs only expose mint/burn(to an LP-specified recipient)/skim(dust)/sync; token only transfer/burn. Swap fees accrue to LPs and a fixed feeTo (0x3e8e2dfb...), not to a stranger keeper.
